displayName: AI cost breaker unavailable (cost approval or Apple revocation config)

documentation.content: Either the AI cost-control Firestore doc (service_cost_controls/ai_v1) failed validation — thrown as ServiceCostError('unavailable', 'AI cost approval unavailable.') in functions/pronunciation/service_cost_policy.js and functions/tts/service_cost_policy.js — or the Apple token-revocation secret/config is invalid, thrown as error.code === 'apple/revocation-config-invalid' in functions/gye/apple_revocation_adapter.js. Either means a safety breaker degraded silently: AI endpoints may reject all requests, or account deletions may be stuck unable to revoke Apple grants. First checks: docs/runbooks/ops-alerts.md#03. Metrics: two log-based counters created by tool/ops/log_metrics.sh.

_requires: tool/ops/log_metrics.sh must run before apply_alerts, so these two logging.googleapis.com/user/* metrics exist
_unverified_reason: Creating log metric descriptors does not prove matching diagnostic events are emitted. TTS catches ServiceCostError and translates it before the generic error logger; a thrown message alone is not Cloud Logging evidence. Both cost-policy and Apple-revocation event emission, deployed revision, filters and receipt must be validated before enabling this policy.
